usageNotes: Updates an existing entry within an SDN route map, identified by its zero-based order index. Use this to change the matching policy (permit/deny), add or modify match conditions and set actions, or chain to another route map via the 'call' field. SDN changes made here are staged and require a subsequent apply (POST /cluster/sdn) to take effect in the data plane; requires SDN.Allocate on the specific route-map path.

examples.summary: Change entry 10 of route map 'rm-upstream' to deny, with an on-match-next exit action

tips: Supply the 'digest' param (from the GET response) to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other.
The 'order' path param is the current index of the entry — it does not reorder the entry; use it only to target which entry to modify.
Use the 'delete' array to remove specific sub-fields (e.g. a match condition) without replacing the whole entry.
The 'call' field delegates to a second route map mid-evaluation; the called map runs and returns control to the next entry in the calling map.
After updating entries, run POST /cluster/sdn to apply the pending configuration to all SDN nodes.
